Class RelateBillToStripeTransactionsQueueable

public without sharing class RelateBillToStripeTransactionsQueueable
implements Queueable

Queueable job that relates Bill__c records to their corresponding StripeTransaction__c records by invoking a configurable Flow. Uses the CursorIterator pattern to process bills one at a time across multiple queueable executions, allowing for large datasets to be processed without hitting governor limits.

Methods

public void execute(QueueableContext context)

Executes the queueable job to process the next Bill__c record in the cursor. Initializes the CursorIterator on first execution, invokes the configured Flow to relate the bill to its Stripe transactions, and chains to the next queueable execution if more records remain.

Parameters:
    context – The QueueableContext provided by the Salesforce platform
